Republicans keep forcing through some of the shadiest, most unqualified nominees I’ve ever seen.

The Trump loyalists in today’s package are no different, like Darin Smith for the District Court of Wyoming.

He’s not only underqualified but was at the Capitol on January 6th.

Disgusting. Trump reaches a new low every day.

Hegseth and Trump call their war with Iran an “astounding victory”

13 American servicemembers have been killed.

400 have been wounded.

The Pentagon says it’s spent at least $25 billion.

This is not a victory. They need to roll up their sleeves & bring a diplomatic end to this mess.

After weeks of leaving Congress in the dark about the state of Trump’s disastrous war, Pete Hegseth came to the Capitol to testify. After his attempt to blame Democrats, one thing was left very clear:

The greatest obstacle to peace is the incompetence of the Secretary of Defense and of the President of the United States.
